Describes the key, not a person. Branch on `grant.restricted`: true means the key reaches only the spaces in `spaces`; false means every space, either an all-spaces grant or a legacy key with no grant. An all-spaces grant reports `space_count` and lists its spaces only when `spaces` is true.
